reviews.title: Elite 360mm cooling performance with a stunning look
reviews.comment: We’ve tested a lot of AIOs, but the Thermalright Aqua Elite 360 V6 really stands out for its balance of premium cooling power and budget-friendly pricing. Dealing with high-heat chips like the latest AM5 or Intel 14th gen can be a challenge, but this 360mm radiator setup handles them with ease, keeping temperatures stable even under heavy rendering or gaming loads. The installation was straightforward across both platforms—it’s great to see support for the newer Intel LGA 1851 and AMD AM5 sockets right out of the box. The ARGB effects on the pump head and the three 120mm fans are vibrant and sync perfectly with motherboard software, giving the build a high-end, customized feel. We also noticed the pump operates very quietly, which is a huge plus for anyone building a silent workstation. The build quality of the tubing and the radiator feels solid and durable. For a liquid cooler in this price bracket, getting this level of thermal overhead and visual flair is impressive. It’s a reliable AIO CPU Cooler that we’d highly recommend for anyone looking to push their hardware without breaking the bank.
reviews.author: AverageJoe

reviews.title: Works great for the price! Big temp differences on our build.
reviews.comment: So far this cooler is doing well keeping my temps around 7-10 degrees cooler, depending on the game. Idle has gone down about 5-6 degrees to between 38-42 Celsius compared to a single tower air cooler (Arctic 36) where it idled around 45-47c. Installation was relatively straightforward with some minor issues when installing the water block, but that was likely just cuz it was our first time installing an aio. Good instructions on how to connect via MB, and overall great performance with a 9600x. RGB looks great and goes well with the other Thermalright fans in the build. Awesome cooler!
reviews.author: Isabella Sledge

reviews.title: Best bang for your buck for the budget Ballers
reviews.comment: After searching online for a week for a good CPU cooler, I stumble across this one and after multiple reviews, I’ve watched I could not pass up the opportunity to grab this i have an intel ultra 7 265kf and before I was using a phantom spirit 120 Evo the temps on that were OK, but I wanted to go sub 60c (i have ocd) and i gotta say this product delivers while gaming on warzone my cpu stays at around 55-58c on alan wake 2 its closer to 50c at idle im under 28c I gotta say it’s keeping my system cooler and dissipates heat like crazy. It might be a bit overkill, but for the longevity of my components, I think it’s worth it especially for the price. The RGB is phenomenal and bright the install was straightforward. It fit my LGA 1851. As for durability, I don’t know yet. I’ve only had it for about a day, but I gotta say performance is amazing and the build quality is superb considering the price if you’re planning on buying this, I highly recommend it plenty of reviews on mine praise this as well it’s an amazing AIO
